source: Seat capture at 2026-10-14T07:11Z of the lane launcher per-run receipts captured in the A39_LANE_RECEIPTS_C2_INPUT.tsv file, together with each lane's own final stdout line of the form LANE: STATUS sha. Host labels in the rows are recorded by the launcher (bm1, bmb, mb, mini1, mini3, ubuntu0, ubuntu1, ubuntu2, ubuntu3). This file is an SNI-local draft contract that consumes those owner-supplied receipt values.

rung_rules.note: Launcher refused or failed before the remote CLI started; 75 is a launcher admission refusal, 76 is a lease refusal, 78 is an admission refusal at a different launcher stage. The lane never started. START and every later rung stay unclaimed even if launched_at is present.

rung_rules.when: rc is None and done_at is None
rung_rules.note: Capture ended with no DONE event. This is never DELIVERED.
124 is a launcher timeout; 1 is a non-zero remote CLI exit.

rung_rules.when: rc == 0 and lane, status, lane_head are all present and output_complete is not False
rung_rules.note: output_complete may be None for non-native launcher modes; that alone does not block DELIVERED.

rung_rules.when: rc == 0 and any of lane, status, lane_head is missing
rung_rules.note: No parseable final line. This is never DELIVERED.

rung_rules.rung_reached: never claim CI, MERGED, PRODUCTION_PROOF, ACCEPTANCE
rung_rules.note: CI, MERGED, PRODUCTION_PROOF, and ACCEPTANCE are never claimed by this capture.
integrated_on_main records a cherry-pick trailer naming lane_head on main. The rung stays DELIVERED. Integration is not acceptance.

bounds: Launcher receipts captured at 2026-10-14T07:11Z are the only source.
Lanes launched by other seats are not covered.
Rows past DELIVERED need per-row CI and merge receipts, which this capture does not hold.
integrated_on_main records a cherry-pick trailer on main and is not acceptance.
A PASS status is the lane's own claim, judged separately by the seat.
Usage tokens are absent for non-native launcher modes.
rc 78 is a launcher admission refusal.
No row in this ledger is at CI, MERGED, PRODUCTION_PROOF, or ACCEPTANCE.
This draft consumes owner-supplied receipt values; it does not mint issuer or security identifiers.
This module does not feed a ranker, gate, sizer, escalation, or trade path.
